response.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref GROUP BY s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, avg_ambictemp, avg_imgcount, avg_imgcount - AVG(avg_imgcount) OVER () AS imgcount_diff_from_mean_of_status_avgs FROM per_status

assumptions.assumption: A NULL entrystat in sites is treated as its own group and is included in the per-status equal-weight mean. A status whose imgcount values are all NULL has a NULL average and is excluded from the mean of averages, since AVG ignores NULLs.
